schema_notes: Machine-readable AC.9 red/green replay evidence. Every sha is a full 40-hex immutable commit id resolved from the finding documents and fix branches and verified by ancestry (base -> red -> green -> [final]) before any replay runs. replay_groups[] = findings WITH a minimal local fix; each carries an execution record proving the standalone regression failed at the red revision for the recorded reason and passed at every later revision. non_fixed_findings[] = findings with NO fix evidence (operator parity ruling, comment-only doc fixes, pending contract decisions) documented separately so they are never counted as fix evidence. Validated by tests/properties/test_finding_evidence_complete.py; replayed by investigation/finding_regression_replay.py (opt-in wrapper: tests/properties/test_finding_regression_replay.py).
campaign_base_note: pre-investigation discovery HEAD, identical to the Testing tip at campaign start; every fix branch is rooted here
replay_environment_note: Each revision runs in a disposable detached git worktree fr-<group> with a fresh uv-built .venv from '.[dev]' (pytest+pandas+textual+hypothesis+mypy+ruff; textual is required by the E-1/E-2 regression, Hypothesis is not needed by any red regression but belongs to the campaign dev environment). Revisions of one group run strictly sequentially in one worktree; the venv is deleted and rebuilt at every revision boundary. One DuckDB default-thread setting is used by the regressions themselves (they were not rewritten); the replay harness adds no parallelism.
